capabilities: Export notes or folders to HWPX
Apply template marker formatting to matching note parts
Install bundled templates and a template guide
Inspect templates for markers and likely typos
Expose export tools to AI agent hosts
extras: Desktop only, using Node.js file system access; no network access, telemetry or account. Third-party code-block renderers are off by default and run other plugins' processors during export. The agentinterop v1 provider is the author's own convention, not an official standard, and the plugin works the same without an agent host.
problem: Obsidian notes cannot be delivered as Hangul word-processor files, and the look of such a document cannot be controlled from inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: The converter is derived from pypandoc-hwpx (MIT)
Verbex is currently the only agent host that implements agentinterop v1

requires.name: Hangul (Hancom Office) or another HWPX viewer

summary: Exports Markdown notes to Hangul HWPX documents, taking character and paragraph formatting from user-edited HWPX templates.
